question: Who produced methane in 1856 by bringing carbon disulphide vapour in contact with red hot copper and hydrogen sulphide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marcelin Berthelot**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Marcelin Berthelot** was a renowned **French chemist** and one of the pioneers in the field of synthetic organic chemistry.
 
• In **1856**, he successfully produced **methane** by passing **carbon disulphide vapour** over **red-hot copper** and **hydrogen sulphide**.
